description: A warm living room vignette photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, framing the back of a sofa, a sideboard, and their relationship to the wall in a three-quarter corner composition. The walls are smooth warm sand-beige plaster with a slight texture and no applied moulding. The floor is wide-plank light oak parquet in a herringbone pattern. A solid dark walnut sofa with a low padded back and natural linen upholstery fills the foreground; a grey herringbone-woven throw is casually draped over its right arm. Behind the sofa, a dark walnut sideboard with flat-panel cabinet doors and a smooth top surface supports a matte black upright table form — a sculptural vertical rod with three smoked glass orb diffusers at staggered heights, plus a glowing circular halo ring element at center-height — that emits a warm amber glow in all directions, washing the pale plaster wall behind it with a soft amber halo. Beside this vertical glowing form, a large-scale floral bouquet in a terracotta ceramic vase overflows with white ranunculus, pink garden roses, dusty miller, and eucalyptus stems. A sheer white linen curtain panel filters the daylight entering from the right-side window. The floor in the foreground right shows a fragment of an upholstered ottoman in dark grey.
